title: Counting Clues: A Lightweight Probabilistic Baseline Can Match an LLM
abstract: arXiv:2512.12868v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel on multiple-choice clinical diagnosis benchmarks, yet it is unclear how much of this performance reflects underlying probabilistic reasoning. We study this through questions from MedQA that ask for the most likely diagnosis. We introduce Frequency-Based Probabilistic Ranker (FBPR), a lightweight method that scores options with a smoothed Naive Bayes over concept-diagnosis co-occurrence statistics from a large corpus. When co-occurrence statistics are sourced from Dolma, the pretraining corpus for OLMo, and RedPajama, an open reproduction of the LLaMA pretraining-data recipe, FBPR achieves comparable performance to the corresponding LLMs. Furthermore, direct LLM inference and FBPR exhibit complementary strengths, correctly answering largely different subsets of questions with overlap barely above chance. Combining them with a simple hybrid method yields a notable gain over either method alone.

translated_title: 计数线索：轻量级概率基线可以匹敌大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在多选临床诊断基准测试中表现出色，但目前尚不清楚这种表现在多大程度上反映了其底层的概率推理能力。我们通过MedQA中要求给出最可能诊断的问题来研究这一问题。我们提出了基于频率的概率排序器（FBPR），这是一种轻量级方法，利用从大型语料库中提取的概念-诊断共现统计信息，通过平滑朴素贝叶斯对选项进行评分。当共现统计信息来源于Dolma（OLMo的预训练语料库）和RedPajama（LLaMA预训练数据配方的开源复现）时，FBPR取得了与相应LLM相当的性能。此外，直接的LLM推理和FBPR展现出互补的优势，两者正确回答的问题子集在很大程度上不同，其重叠率仅略高于随机水平。通过简单的混合方法将两者结合，可以取得显著优于任何单一方法的性能提升。
tldr: 本研究提出基于频率的概率排序器（FBPR），仅利用朴素贝叶斯与大语料库中的概念-诊断共现统计，即可在MedQA诊断任务上达到与LLM相当的性能，且两者互补性强，混合使用可获得更佳效果。
en_tdlr: A lightweight Frequency-Based Probabilistic Ranker using Naive Bayes over concept-diagnosis co-occurrence statistics from large pretraining corpora matches LLM performance on MedQA diagnosis questions, with the two methods showing complementary strengths and hybrid combination yielding notable gains.
